_help: Sheets whose pictures are not an even grid. Key = sheet file name (e.g. 01.jpg). Each box is [left, top, right, bottom] as a fraction (0-1) of the sheet, in story order (the numbers on the sheet). split-sheets.py uses these instead of looking for white lines. (The old 01.jpg and 08.jpg entries were removed: the sheets made by the Canvas tool are clean 3x2 grids and need none.)
